reason: Switch to the planned reserve as the array output falls; that directly addresses the immediate goal.
expectation: The charged battery will be connected to the emergency supply, keeping essential cabin systems powered.

alternatives.reason: Moving stored heat into the nook also protects the garden, but the reserve power goal seems more immediate.

effect: The essential supply is isolated, though the reserve goal has not yet completed, so another connection may be needed.
reaction: It is reassuring to establish the essential supply, but I am curious what remains to switch over.
reason: Put the stored heat where it can protect the plants during reduced power.
expectation: The charged heat store will be positioned in the growing nook to release warmth there.

alternatives.reason: The trench might need attention for the reserve, but its purpose is less clear to me.

effect: The nook now has a heat buffer; the troughs can follow it inside.
reaction: That placement makes physical sense, although the result is terse.
reason: Investigate the service trench with the tool; it may be the remaining reserve preparation.
expectation: I expect to adjust or isolate the water service line, though the exact operation is unclear.

alternatives.reason: Moving the potatoes into the buffered nook is also sensible, but I want to address station services first.

effect: Draining the line completes the reserve preparations and explains how the inlet is protected until thaw checks; now both troughs need shelter.
reaction: The detail about the closed inlet makes the otherwise unclear tool action understandable.
reason: Move the potato trough into the warm nook to protect the longer-growing crop.
expectation: The supported potatoes will be placed inside the buffered nook.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce also needs to be moved; I chose potatoes first because they have longer to grow.

effect: The potatoes are sheltered; the lettuce is the remaining trough to move.
reason: Move the lettuce into the same protected nook; it is the only gameplay option.
expectation: The lettuce trough will be sheltered and the two-trough goal will complete.

effect: The lettuce is sheltered too, completing the chapter; the frozen archive mentioned in the introduction did not become an action here.
reaction: The ending feels abrupt after the introduction raised concern about the archive.

mostWorthwhile.text: Draining the well line and learning that its inlet stays closed until thaw checks gave a concrete sense of how the station copes with cold and reduced power.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs in separate, nearly identical actions felt routine, especially when the second was the only gameplay option.

surprise.text: I did not initially know what using the service tool on the trench would do; the drained line and thaw checks clarified the purpose.

arbitrary.text: The trench action was unclear before selection: the tool and trench alone did not tell me that the line would be drained. Its result explained it afterward.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see how the frozen discovery survives and how the station recovers, though these short placement actions alone are not a strong draw.
